page_title: VIL 2-2 BET | Villarreal v Betis 18/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Now Villarreal have a corner.
90+4' 2 - 2 Antony (Betis) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes inside the left post and past the goalkeeper.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Sofyan Amrabat (Betis) is given a yellow card.
90' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) gets a yellow card. The referee Francisco Maeso made the right call.
90' It's time for a substitution. Pablo Garcia (Betis) comes on in place of Hector Bellerin.
87' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick only goes into the stands. Poor shot!
87' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Francisco Maeso no option but to blow his whistle.
83' Villarreal failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
82' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
81' It is time for a substitution. Manor Solomon (Villarreal) is on for Alfonso Pedraza.
81' Antony (Betis) guides an effort goalwards from the edge of the box, but it sails just wide of the left post.
81' The attendance for today's match is 19238.
79' Junior Firpo (Betis) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
76' Betis have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
75' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 9:9.
74' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) is caught offside!
73' Today's match ends for Dani Parejo who will be replaced by Pape Gueye (Villarreal).
73' Here is a change. Alberto Moleiro is going off and Marcelino gives the last tactical orders to Sergi Cardona (Villarreal).
70' Antony (Betis) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
69' Substitution. Aitor Ruibal (Betis) in, Abde Ezzalzouli out.
66' 2 - 1 Goal! Antony (Betis) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot inside the left post.
64' 2 - 0 Goal! Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner.
63' Marcelino prepares a substitution. Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi is replaced by Ayoze Perez (Villarreal).
63' We are about to witness a substitution. Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) is replacing Gerard Moreno.
61' The current number of corner kicks is 3:5.
58' Junior Firpo (Betis) times his run into the box perfectly and slams a header goalwards from the centre of the box, but it lacks accuracy and flies well wide of the left post.
58' The ball is out of play and Betis manage to earn a corner.
57' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) is coming onto the pitch as Marc Roca cannot continue after picking up an injury.
56' The rebound finds Natan (Betis) in space inside the box, but his shot goes well wide of the left post. That was a promising chance!
56' The referee awards a corner and Antony (Betis) goes over to take it.
56' Antony (Betis) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
55' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the left post.
54' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Francisco Maeso saw the whole situation.
54' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 4:6.
53' Natan (Betis) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar.
53' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Betis.
52' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
51' Valentin Gomez (Betis) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the top of the net but Arnau Tenas keeps it out.
50' A player from Villarreal commits a rough challenge. Francisco Maeso blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Betis take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' 1 - 0 Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.
41' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle and it's Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
37' Antony (Betis) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
34' A fine solo run by Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies well wide of the right post.

33' Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Pau Lopez shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
31' Villarreal can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
31' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
29' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
28' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 39:61.
26' Flag goes up against Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
24' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
21' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) is adjudged offside.
18' Villarreal have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
18' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
17' Francisco Maeso interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Pau Navarro (Villarreal).
16' The total number of attempts is 1:1.
12' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
11' A quickly taken corner by Villarreal.
7' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) approaches the edge of the box with intent and shoots, but Arnau Tenas rushes out to narrow the angle and smothers the ball. Good goalkeeping!
4' Francisco Maeso couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Dani Parejo (Villarreal) and blew his whistle.
3' Hector Bellerin (Betis) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Betis will have the kick-off.
Francisco Maeso will officiate today.
